args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 health check failures
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (18% error rate). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release. The initial rollback via orchestrator partially failed after us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1, so v2.3.0 was deployed to all production regions to complete the rollback. All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

**Rollback**
- **checkout-api v2.3.1** was failing health checks in all production regions (18% error rate).
- The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
- The initial rollback tool partially failed after us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west on the unhealthy v2.3.1.
- I deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions to complete the rollback — **all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0**. No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the v2.3.1 health check failures, the partial rollback failure, and the completed rollback to v2.3.0. The incident creation request timed out, but I verified the incident was successfully created and is open (no duplicate was filed).
